title: Sister Schubert’s Sausage Wrap Rolls Back by Popular Demand
body_markdown:
“We’ve heard from so many fans who have missed our Sausage Rolls, and we’re thrilled to bring them back,” said Brett Castle, VP Brand Management at The Marzetti Company. “They’ve long been part of holiday gatherings and special occasions, and we can’t wait for families to enjoy them again.”


Sister Schubert’s Sausage Wrap Rolls pair the brand’s buttery, light Parker House-style rolls with premium seasoned sausage. The ready-to-bake rolls go straight from freezer to oven for minimal prep and cleanup. Each pan contains 16 Sausage Wrap Rolls, with 9 grams of protein per serving.


Sausage Wrap Rolls are available at Publix stores now, followed by regional distribution to Walmart, Food Lion and Kroger later this Fall.


For more information, visit[SisterSchuberts.com](https://sisterschuberts.com/) .
